shotContent.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riley, 24. <Picture 1> supplies her facial identity: soft, pretty oval face, fair lightly freckled skin, brown eyes, straight brows and round thin silver-wire glasses. <Video 2> confirms the same face and glasses from several angles and supplies her natural, unslimmed body proportions and her outfit: a fitted white scoop-neck tank top, heather-grey drawstring shorts and bare feet. Her hair is auburn, as in both references, but it is styled as the story requires: short, with one side tucked behind her ear. It is not the low ponytail shown in the references. For this shot she also wears a dark over-ear gaming headset with its microphone boom flipped up.
<Subject 2> is Riley's bedroom, supplied by <Picture 2>. It is a small, cluttered night-time room with warm beige walls and a large wall poster of a blonde armoured mage above the desk. The wooden desk holds a single monitor, a backlit mechanical keyboard with a blue underglow, a mouse on a dark pad, a small speaker and a white ceramic mug. Beside the desk is a wooden drawer unit, with a pale lamp shade on it. The room also contains a rumpled single bed with dark clothes on it, a window with a warm wooden frame, a bedside unit with papers and a water bottle, and clothes and shoes on the carpet.
<Subject 3> is Riley's gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. It is a racing-style chair in soft pink faux leather with white accents and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping. The back of the backrest is a smooth pink panel with two black-rimmed shoulder slots near the top. It has black adjustable armrests and a black five-star base with pink leg inlays and twin-wheel casters.
<Subject 4> is the League of Legends client on the monitor, supplied by <Picture 3>. It uses a dark navy-and-gold interface with a bright, luminous champion-select panel at its centre.
summary:
Generate a static, high-angle wide shot of <Subject 2> at night, seen from a ceiling-height far corner, with a very slow, slight push-in. <Subject 1> sits in <Subject 3> at the monitor-lit desk, visibly frustrated with matchmaking. The shot establishes a cozy, messy gamer's den in cool blue screen light against warm darkness. The shot contains no dialogue.
retention_analysis:
From <Picture 1>, keep only Riley's face, glasses and hair colour. Do not keep its neutral backdrop, grey top, frontal pose or ponytail styling.
From <Video 2>, keep her face and glasses consistency, her body proportions, the white tank top, the grey drawstring shorts and her bare feet. Use its rear and three-quarter views for her appearance from this high rear-side angle. Do not keep its white backdrop, standing pose, turntable orbit, timing or ponytail.
From <Picture 2>, keep the room layout, poster, desk, keyboard, monitor, mug, bed, window, clutter and warm materials. Change the following:
- Switch the ceiling light and the lamp off, so the monitor is the dominant light source.
- Move the pile of unopened envelopes onto the desk corner.
- Remove the headset from the desk, because Riley is wearing it.
- Replace the doorway viewpoint with a new far-corner high angle.
- Show no ceiling dent.
From <Video 1>, keep the chair's design from the rear and side. Do not keep its white backdrop, orbit or timing.
From <Picture 3>, keep only the client's colour palette and glow. At this distance the screen stays illegible. Do not show LOCKED IN, the Elementalist skin or any readable lettering.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 7.29 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts.

The camera is fixed high in the far corner of <Subject 2>, just below the ceiling, looking down diagonally across the cramped room toward the desk wall. The room sits in near-darkness. The overhead light and the lamp are off. The only real light is the cool blue-white glow of the monitor and the faint blue underglow of the keyboard. That light washes across the desk and the poster above it, and falls off into warm brown-amber shadow over the rumpled bed, the scattered clothes, the shoes on the carpet and the dark window.

The desk is visibly neglected. The white mug is left unwashed beside the keyboard, and a loose, slumping pile of unopened envelopes sits on the desk corner. At the centre of the desk sits the one obviously premium object: a sleek, extremely expensive mechanical keyboard with a crisp backlit glow.

<Subject 1> sits centred in the frame in <Subject 3>, seen from above and behind at a three-quarter angle. The chair's smooth pink back, shoulder slots and faint iridescent piping catch the screen light. Riley's white tank top glows pale blue in the monitor light. Her bare legs are folded forward under the desk. Her short auburn hair is tucked behind one ear, the round silver frames glint at her temple, and the dark headset sits over her ears with its mic boom flipped up. On <Subject 4>, the champion-select screen radiates navy, gold and violet light, too small and distant to read.

At the start of the take, Riley is hunched toward the screen, one hand on the mouse, her shoulders tense. She clicks twice and waits. Her head tilts in disbelief at whatever the matchmaker has decided. She lets go of the mouse and drops back into the chair, which rocks slightly on its base. Her arms flop onto the armrests, and she exhales visibly, her shoulders rising and sinking.

She stays sprawled back for a beat, staring at the monitor, lips pressed in quiet defeat. Then she leans forward again and rests her right hand on the desk beside the keyboard. Her fingertips begin to drum in a slow, impatient rhythm against the wood.

Throughout the take, the camera holds its high corner position and creeps forward with only a very slow, slight push. The push never becomes a move toward a close shot.

At the end of the take, the frame is the same high corner wide, framed only a touch tighter. Riley is centred at the glowing desk, the monitor light haloing her head and headset, and her fingers are still drumming as the take ends.
overall_soundscape:
Dim, lived-in late-night stillness. The PC fans hum softly and the room tone is quiet. There are two light mouse clicks, a soft creak and roll as the chair takes her weight, and her faint exhale. Her fingertips drum on the wooden desk in a dry, rhythmic patter. Outside the window there is only a faint, distant hush. There is no dialogue.
non_diegetic_music:
A soft, quirky lo-fi pulse, low in the mix, sitting beneath the room tone and the drumming.

videos.name: Gaming chair reference
videos.description: Intended use: this reel is meant to define a modern racing-style gaming chair for later shots. It describes an intended design, not verified output. The chair is upholstered in soft pink faux leather with white accents. It has a tall winged backrest with white side bolsters, a diamond-quilted pink centre panel and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping along the backrest and seat. A white headrest pillow carries a small grey printed wordmark. Two black straps run down to a lumbar pillow with a pink centre, white side bands and a white chevron emblem. The seat is a pink bucket seat with white bolsters. The chair has black adjustable armrests with flat black pads, one with a short silver section on its post. Underneath are a black recline mechanism with a lever on one side, a black height lever, a black seat base and gas cylinder, and a black five-star base with pink inlay panels on each leg and black twin-wheel casters. The completed sides are newly designed to match the visible ones. The back of the backrest is intended as a smooth pink panel framed by white side sections and piping, with the headrest pillow straps visible. The opposite side is intended to mirror the visible armrest and bolster styling. Later shots should place the chair with their own position, scale, framing, lighting, camera motion and action. They should not inherit this reel's orbit, white backdrop or timing unless their own instructions call for it. Explicit target-shot instructions may change the chair's condition or surroundings.

shotContent.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riley, 24, known online as SparkleRiley. <Picture 1> supplies her facial identity: a soft, pretty oval face, fair lightly freckled skin, brown eyes, straight brows and round thin silver-wire glasses. <Video 2> confirms the same face and glasses from several angles. It also supplies her natural, unslimmed body proportions, her rear and three-quarter silhouette, and her outfit: a fitted white scoop-neck tank top, heather-grey drawstring shorts and bare feet. Her hair is auburn, as in both references, but is styled as the story requires: short, with the right side tucked behind her right ear. It is not the low ponytail shown in the references.
<Subject 2> is Riley's bedroom, supplied by <Picture 4>. It has warm beige walls and a large poster of a blonde armoured mage above a wooden desk. The desk holds a single black monitor on a stand, a backlit RGB mechanical keyboard, a mouse on a dark pad, small black speakers and a white ceramic mug. A pale shaded table lamp stands at the right end of the desk and is switched off.
<Subject 3> is Riley's racing-style gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. It is upholstered in soft pink faux leather. The back of the backrest is a smooth pink panel with two black-rimmed shoulder slots near the top and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping.
<Subject 4> is Riley's gaming headset, supplied by <Picture 3>. It is a matte-black over-ear headset with a padded headband and leather earcups. A thin glowing blue ring circles each outer earcup, and a slim black microphone boom ends in a foam tip.
<Subject 5> is the League of Legends champion-select client on the monitor, supplied by <Picture 2>. It has dark navy panels, thin gold borders, gold-and-white serif lettering and the square TOP role icon.
<Audio 1> is the Posh Riley voice recording, mapped to Riley (S1). It supplies her voice timbre only.
summary:
Generate a static over-the-shoulder medium close-up from behind Riley's right shoulder toward her monitor at night. The back of <Subject 1>'s auburn head and the flipped-up, muted microphone of <Subject 4> fill the foreground. <Subject 5> dominates the frame beyond them and reads ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP. Riley considers the assignment, tilts her head and delivers one deadpan line to the screen. The shot is intimate and lit by the monitor, with cool navy-and-gold light against a dark room.
retention_analysis:
From <Picture 1>, keep only Riley's face, freckles, eye colour, glasses and hair colour. Do not keep its neutral backdrop, grey top, frontal pose or ponytail.
From <Video 2>, keep her proportions, her rear and three-quarter head-and-shoulder silhouette, the white tank top and the glasses seen from behind and from the side. Do not keep the white backdrop, standing pose, turntable orbit, timing or ponytail. Her hair is short and tucked behind her right ear.
From <Picture 3>, keep the headset design and the blue earcup rings. Place the headset on Riley's head with the microphone boom on her right, camera-side earcup, swung straight up and muted. Do not keep the white backdrop or the resting pose.
From <Video 1>, keep only the top edge of the pink backrest, with its shoulder slots and piping, low in the foreground. Do not keep the white backdrop, orbit or timing.
From <Picture 4>, keep the desk, monitor, keyboard glow, mug, speakers, dark lamp and the edge of the poster. Change the following:
- Keep the lamp and the ceiling light off.
- Place a small pile of unopened envelopes on the desk.
- Leave no headset on the desk, because Riley is wearing it.
- Replace the source viewpoint with this over-the-shoulder angle.
- Show no ceiling dent.
From <Picture 2>, keep only the client's navy-and-gold style, its typography, its gold frames and the TOP role icon. The screen shows the pre-pick assignment, with a bold central banner reading ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP. Do not show LOCKED IN, LUX, Elementalist, the skin carousel, the splash art or readable champion portraits. All other interface detail stays soft and illegible.
From <Audio 1>, keep only Riley's voice timbre. Never use the recording's words.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 6.58 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off and does not move at all.

The camera sits just behind and slightly above Riley's right shoulder, in a tight over-the-shoulder medium close-up aimed at the monitor. In the left and centre foreground, slightly soft, is the back of <Subject 1>'s head. Her short auburn hair is tucked behind her right ear, and the thin silver arm of her round glasses catches a glint at her temple. The white strap of her tank top sits on her bare right shoulder. <Subject 4> sits over her ears, and its right earcup's thin blue ring glows faintly. Its microphone boom is flipped straight up beside her ear and is plainly muted and idle, a dark vertical silhouette against the screen glow. The rounded top of <Subject 3>'s pink backrest, with one black-rimmed shoulder slot, just edges into the lower frame.

Beyond her, in sharp focus, <Subject 5> fills most of the right and centre of the frame. It is dark navy with gold filigree borders. A large gold-edged banner at its centre reads ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP beside the square TOP role icon. That is the only legible text, and the surrounding panels stay soft. The monitor is the only real light. Its cool navy-blue glow, with warm gold highlights, rims her hair, ear and cheek edge. <Subject 2> falls away into near-darkness around it. The keyboard's faint rainbow underglow shows at the lower edge, and the pale shape of the unlit lamp and the lower edge of the poster are barely discernible.

At the start of the take, Riley is completely still, reading the banner, and her shoulders are square. She holds for a long beat, considering. Around the second second, she tilts her head slowly to the right. Her cheek and the edge of her glasses turn a few degrees toward the camera, and her jaw becomes just visible in profile. She pauses there, unimpressed.

Then, without looking away from the screen, she speaks flatly and evenly, her jaw moving subtly in partial profile. Riley (S1) says <d>[English] Support is a mindset, not a location.</d>

She delivers the line with complete deadpan conviction, with no gesture, only a slight settle of the shoulders. After the line, her head eases back upright, and she holds her gaze on the screen.

At the end of the take, the frame is the same over-the-shoulder composition as at the start. The back of her head and the raised microphone are in the foreground, and ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP still dominates the glowing screen.
overall_soundscape:
The room has a deadpan, intimate late-night quiet: low room tone and the soft hum of the PC fans. A faint electronic ambience plays from the champion-select client through the headset. Her hair makes a small rustle against the earcup as she tilts her head. Her dry, flat voice is close and clear, with no room echo. Nothing else sounds.
non_diegetic_music:
The soft, quirky lo-fi pulse from the previous shot continues. It stays low in the mix and sits beneath the dialogue without swelling.

Its LOCKED IN state, Lux Elementalist splash art and skin carousel belong to the next shot and are excluded, and the screen instead reads ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP. <Picture 3>: the headset design and blue earcup rings. subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riley, 24, known online as SparkleRiley. <Picture 1> supplies her facial identity: a soft, pretty oval face, fair lightly freckled skin, brown eyes, straight brows and round thin silver-wire glasses. <Video 2> confirms the same face and glasses from several angles. It also supplies her natural, unslimmed body proportions, her rear and three-quarter silhouette, and her outfit: a fitted white scoop-neck tank top, heather-grey drawstring shorts and bare feet. Her hair is auburn, as in both references, but is styled as the story requires: short, with the right side tucked behind her right ear. It is not the low ponytail shown in the references.
<Subject 2> is Riley's bedroom, supplied by <Picture 4>. It has warm beige walls and a large poster of a blonde armoured mage above a wooden desk. The desk holds a single black monitor on a stand, a backlit RGB mechanical keyboard, a mouse on a dark pad, small black speakers and a white ceramic mug. A pale shaded table lamp stands at the right end of the desk and is switched off.
<Subject 3> is Riley's racing-style gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. It is upholstered in soft pink faux leather. The back of the backrest is a smooth pink panel with two black-rimmed shoulder slots near the top and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping.
<Subject 4> is Riley's gaming headset, supplied by <Picture 3>. It is a matte-black over-ear headset with a padded headband and leather earcups. A thin glowing blue ring circles each outer earcup, and a slim black microphone boom ends in a foam tip.
<Subject 5> is the League of Legends champion-select client on the monitor, supplied by <Picture 2>. It has dark navy panels, thin gold borders, gold-and-white serif lettering and the square TOP role icon.
<Audio 1> is the Posh Riley voice recording, mapped to Riley (S1). It supplies her voice timbre only.
summary:
Generate a static over-the-shoulder medium close-up from behind Riley's right shoulder toward her monitor at night. The back of <Subject 1>'s auburn head and the flipped-up, muted microphone of <Subject 4> fill the foreground. <Subject 5> dominates the frame beyond them and reads ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP. Riley considers the assignment, tilts her head and delivers one deadpan line to the screen. The shot is intimate and lit by the monitor, with cool navy-and-gold light against a dark room.
retention_analysis:
From <Picture 1>, keep only Riley's face, freckles, eye colour, glasses and hair colour. Do not keep its neutral backdrop, grey top, frontal pose or ponytail.
From <Video 2>, keep her proportions, her rear and three-quarter head-and-shoulder silhouette, the white tank top and the glasses seen from behind and from the side. Do not keep the white backdrop, standing pose, turntable orbit, timing or ponytail. Her hair is short and tucked behind her right ear.
From <Picture 3>, keep the headset design and the blue earcup rings. Place the headset on Riley's head with the microphone boom on her right, camera-side earcup, swung straight up and muted. Do not keep the white backdrop or the resting pose.
From <Video 1>, keep only the top edge of the pink backrest, with its shoulder slots and piping, low in the foreground. Do not keep the white backdrop, orbit or timing.
From <Picture 4>, keep the desk, monitor, keyboard glow, mug, speakers, dark lamp and the edge of the poster. Change the following:
- Keep the lamp and the ceiling light off.
- Place a small pile of unopened envelopes on the desk.
- Leave no headset on the desk, because Riley is wearing it.
- Replace the source viewpoint with this over-the-shoulder angle.
- Show no ceiling dent.
From <Picture 2>, keep only the client's navy-and-gold style, its typography, its gold frames and the TOP role icon. The screen shows the pre-pick assignment, with a bold central banner reading ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP. Do not show LOCKED IN, LUX, Elementalist, the skin carousel, the splash art or readable champion portraits. All other interface detail stays soft and illegible.
From <Audio 1>, keep only Riley's voice timbre. Never use the recording's words.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 6.58 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is locked off and does not move at all.

The camera sits just behind and slightly above Riley's right shoulder, in a tight over-the-shoulder medium close-up aimed at the monitor. In the left and centre foreground, slightly soft, is the back of <Subject 1>'s head. Her short auburn hair is tucked behind her right ear, and the thin silver arm of her round glasses catches a glint at her temple. The white strap of her tank top sits on her bare right shoulder. <Subject 4> sits over her ears, and its right earcup's thin blue ring glows faintly. Its microphone boom is flipped straight up beside her ear and is plainly muted and idle, a dark vertical silhouette against the screen glow. The rounded top of <Subject 3>'s pink backrest, with one black-rimmed shoulder slot, just edges into the lower frame.

Beyond her, in sharp focus, <Subject 5> fills most of the right and centre of the frame. It is dark navy with gold filigree borders. A large gold-edged banner at its centre reads ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP beside the square TOP role icon. That is the only legible text, and the surrounding panels stay soft. The monitor is the only real light. Its cool navy-blue glow, with warm gold highlights, rims her hair, ear and cheek edge. <Subject 2> falls away into near-darkness around it. The keyboard's faint rainbow underglow shows at the lower edge, and the pale shape of the unlit lamp and the lower edge of the poster are barely discernible.

At the start of the take, Riley is completely still, reading the banner, and her shoulders are square. She holds for a long beat, considering. Around the second second, she tilts her head slowly to the right. Her cheek and the edge of her glasses turn a few degrees toward the camera, and her jaw becomes just visible in profile. She pauses there, unimpressed.

Then, without looking away from the screen, she speaks flatly and evenly, her jaw moving subtly in partial profile. Riley (S1) says <d>[English] Support is a mindset, not a location.</d>

She delivers the line with complete deadpan conviction, with no gesture, only a slight settle of the shoulders. After the line, her head eases back upright, and she holds her gaze on the screen.

At the end of the take, the frame is the same over-the-shoulder composition as at the start. The back of her head and the raised microphone are in the foreground, and ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP still dominates the glowing screen.
overall_soundscape:
The room has a deadpan, intimate late-night quiet: low room tone and the soft hum of the PC fans. A faint electronic ambience plays from the champion-select client through the headset. Her hair makes a small rustle against the earcup as she tilts her head. Her dry, flat voice is close and clear, with no room echo. Nothing else sounds.
non_diegetic_music:
The soft, quirky lo-fi pulse from the previous shot continues. It stays low in the mix and sits beneath the dialogue without swelling.
history.referenceUsage: <Picture 1>: Riley's face, freckles, brown eyes, round silver glasses and auburn hair colour. Its ponytail, grey top and backdrop are discarded. <Picture 2>: the League client's navy-and-gold interface style, typography and TOP role icon only. Its LOCKED IN state, Lux Elementalist splash art and skin carousel belong to the next shot and are excluded, and the screen instead reads ASSIGNED POSITION: TOP. <Picture 3>: the headset design and blue earcup rings. It is worn with the microphone boom flipped up and muted, and the backdrop is discarded. <Picture 4>: the bedroom's desk, monitor, keyboard, mug, dark lamp and poster edge, seen from a new angle with the lamp off. <Video 1>: the top of the pink chair backrest, with its shoulder slots and piping, low in the foreground. Its orbit and backdrop are not used. <Video 2>: Riley's proportions, rear and three-quarter head-and-shoulder silhouette and white tank top. Its ponytail is replaced with short hair tucked behind her ear, and its turntable motion and backdrop are not used. <Audio 1>: Posh Riley's voice timbre for Riley (S1) only. Its sample words are never used.

videos.name: Gaming chair reference
videos.description: Intended use: this reel is meant to define a modern racing-style gaming chair for later shots. It describes an intended design, not verified output. The chair is upholstered in soft pink faux leather with white accents. It has a tall winged backrest with white side bolsters, a diamond-quilted pink centre panel and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping along the backrest and seat. A white headrest pillow carries a small grey printed wordmark. Two black straps run down to a lumbar pillow with a pink centre, white side bands and a white chevron emblem. The seat is a pink bucket seat with white bolsters. The chair has black adjustable armrests with flat black pads, one with a short silver section on its post. Underneath are a black recline mechanism with a lever on one side, a black height lever, a black seat base and gas cylinder, and a black five-star base with pink inlay panels on each leg and black twin-wheel casters. The completed sides are newly designed to match the visible ones. The back of the backrest is intended as a smooth pink panel framed by white side sections and piping, with the headrest pillow straps visible. The opposite side is intended to mirror the visible armrest and bolster styling. Later shots should place the chair with their own position, scale, framing, lighting, camera motion and action. They should not inherit this reel's orbit, white backdrop or timing unless their own instructions call for it. Explicit target-shot instructions may change the chair's condition or surroundings.

shotContent.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the League of Legends champion-select client on Riley's screen, supplied by <Picture 2>. It has dark navy panels, thin gold filigree borders and gold-and-white serif lettering. On the left is a gold-framed player card reading SparkleRiley, LUX and TOP, with a small square TOP role icon, above four dim role rows. On the right is a grid of champion portraits with the Lux portrait gold-framed at top left. At the lower centre is a skin carousel with thumbnails labelled Classic, Elementalist and Steel Legion, flanked by gold arrows and five pagination dots. Below it is a glowing blue-and-gold lock button. The central splash art shows Lux in the Elementalist skin: pale platinum hair, violet eyes, a delicate crystal-set circlet, a gold star-tipped staff and one hand raised toward a floating lavender crystal. Behind her is a luminous rainbow stained-glass window, with lavender petals drifting across it.
<Subject 2> is Riley's black computer monitor, supplied by <Picture 4>. It has thin black bezels and stands on the desk of her dark bedroom at night.
summary:
Generate a static, square-on close insert of <Subject 2>'s screen. At the start, <Subject 1> is caught at the moment a mouse cursor locks in LUX. The cursor then selects the ELEMENTALIST skin, and Lux's elegant lavender fantasy-mage outfit blooms across the preview. The shot ends on a full-screen, glowing Elementalist skin preview. The look is glossy and luminous, with cool navy UI and warm gold accents giving way to radiant lavender-blue light.
retention_analysis:
From <Picture 2>, keep the client's layout, navy-and-gold styling, typography, player card, champion grid, skin carousel, lock button and the Elementalist splash composition. That includes Lux's pose, her staff, the crystal circlet, the floating crystal, the stained-glass window and the drifting petals. Keep these visible words exactly as lettered: SparkleRiley, LUX, TOP, ELEMENTALIST, Classic, Elementalist, Steel Legion and LOCKED IN. The champion-grid search and filter text and the role rows may stay soft. Change the following:
- At the opening, the carousel sits on Classic, and the centre shows the blonde Classic Lux art.
- Adapt the Elementalist outfit to the authored design. It has an iridescent lavender-blue corset bodice with a high silver collar, sculpted metallic hip armour, a short layered skirt in lavender and deep blue, long fitted lavender gauntlets with silver detailing, and a delicate crystal-set circlet. Replace the long trailing skirt panels with this short layered skirt.
- At the end, the preview expands so that it fills the whole screen.
<Picture 4> supplies only the black monitor bezel at the frame edges. None of its room, lamp, poster or desk is visible.
<Picture 1>, <Picture 3>, <Video 1>, <Video 2> and <Audio 1> contribute nothing to this insert. They are scene continuity references only. Riley, her headset and her chair are off-screen and must not appear, not even as reflections.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 6.58 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is completely locked off and square-on to <Subject 2>'s screen. The shot is a close insert: <Subject 1> fills almost the entire frame, with only a sliver of black bezel at the edges. The screen is the only light source, and it glows against total darkness. This opening is deliberately different from the previous over-the-shoulder frame. Riley's head and microphone are gone, and there is no ASSIGNED POSITION banner.

At the start, the champion-select screen is fully laid out. The gold-framed player card on the left reads SparkleRiley, LUX and TOP. The Lux portrait at the top left of the right-hand grid carries a bright gold frame. At the centre is the blonde Classic Lux splash, and the carousel below is set to Classic. A small white pointer cursor rests on the lock button at the lower centre.

At about 0.5 seconds, the cursor clicks. The button flares with a gold-and-blue pulse and reads LOCKED IN, and a check mark lights beside it. A ripple of gold light runs along the panel borders.

From about 1.3 seconds, the cursor glides up to the carousel and settles on the middle thumbnail, labelled Elementalist. At about 2.3 seconds, it clicks. The thumbnail's frame turns gold, and the label Elementalist brightens to gold. The Classic splash dissolves in a burst of lavender sparkles and drifting petals. Lux in her Elementalist skin resolves in its place, with the title LUX over ELEMENTALIST in elegant serif lettering beneath her.

From about 3.2 seconds, the preview blooms outward. The side panels, grid and carousel dim and slide back into the navy edges. The splash grows until it fills the whole screen. The outfit is now clear: the iridescent lavender-blue corset bodice shimmers, and the high silver collar catches the light. Sculpted metallic hip armour frames a short layered skirt in lavender and deep blue. Long fitted gauntlets gleam with silver detailing, and the delicate crystal-set circlet glints in her pale hair. The stained-glass window behind her radiates rainbow light, the crystal above her open hand pulses, and petals keep drifting.

At the end of the take, the screen is a full-frame Elementalist preview, glowing lavender and gold. It is soft-bloomed and luminous, and the cursor has faded away. The only motion left is the drifting petals and a gentle shimmer of light.
overall_soundscape:
The insert is glossy and luminous, with the quiet of a late-night room underneath: faint PC fan hum and low room tone. There is a crisp, close mouse click at the lock-in, followed by the client's bright metallic lock-in confirmation sound. A lighter click selects the skin, and a soft, airy shimmer-whoosh plays as the Elementalist art blooms in and expands. A faint crystalline sparkle lingers under the final glowing hold. There is no speech.
non_diegetic_music:
A small, sparkly chime plays in the score as the Elementalist skin lands and blooms. It is light and bright and decays gently into the glowing final hold. Nothing else plays in the score.
shotContent.referenceUsage:
<Picture 2> is the core reference. It supplies the champion-select client: its layout, lettering, player card, portrait grid, skin carousel, lock button and the Elementalist splash composition. The Elementalist outfit is adjusted to the authored description, most notably a short layered skirt instead of the long trailing panels. The opening state is changed to the Classic skin, and the ending expands the preview to full screen.
<Picture 4> supplies only the black monitor and bezel. The room is not visible in this insert.
<Picture 1> (Riley's face), <Picture 3> (headset), <Video 1> (pink gaming chair) and <Video 2> (Riley's identity and outfit) are continuity-only references and contribute nothing visible. None of these subjects appears in this screen insert.
<Audio 1> is the Posh Riley voice, mapped to Riley. It is unused because the shot has no dialogue.

On the left is a gold-framed player card reading SparkleRiley, LUX and TOP, with a small square TOP role icon, above four dim role rows. On the right is a grid of champion portraits with the Lux portrait gold-framed at top left. At the lower centre is a skin carousel with thumbnails labelled Classic, Elementalist and Steel Legion, flanked by gold arrows and five pagination dots. Below it is a glowing blue-and-gold lock button. The central splash art shows Lux in the Elementalist skin: pale platinum hair, violet eyes, a delicate crystal-set circlet, a gold star-tipped staff and one hand raised toward a floating lavender crystal. Behind her is a luminous rainbow stained-glass window, with lavender petals drifting across it.
<Subject 2> is Riley's black computer monitor, supplied by <Picture 4>. It has thin black bezels and stands on the desk of her dark bedroom at night.
summary:
Generate a static, square-on close insert of <Subject 2>'s screen. At the start, <Subject 1> is caught at the moment a mouse cursor locks in LUX. The cursor then selects the ELEMENTALIST skin, and Lux's elegant lavender fantasy-mage outfit blooms across the preview. The shot ends on a full-screen, glowing Elementalist skin preview. The look is glossy and luminous, with cool navy UI and warm gold accents giving way to radiant lavender-blue light.
retention_analysis:
From <Picture 2>, keep the client's layout, navy-and-gold styling, typography, player card, champion grid, skin carousel, lock button and the Elementalist splash composition. That includes Lux's pose, her staff, the crystal circlet, the floating crystal, the stained-glass window and the drifting petals. Keep these visible words exactly as lettered: SparkleRiley, LUX, TOP, ELEMENTALIST, Classic, Elementalist, Steel Legion and LOCKED IN. The champion-grid search and filter text and the role rows may stay soft. Change the following:
- At the opening, the carousel sits on Classic, and the centre shows the blonde Classic Lux art.
- Adapt the Elementalist outfit to the authored design. It has an iridescent lavender-blue corset bodice with a high silver collar, sculpted metallic hip armour, a short layered skirt in lavender and deep blue, long fitted lavender gauntlets with silver detailing, and a delicate crystal-set circlet. Replace the long trailing skirt panels with this short layered skirt.
- At the end, the preview expands so that it fills the whole screen.
<Picture 4> supplies only the black monitor bezel at the frame edges. None of its room, lamp, poster or desk is visible.
<Picture 1>, <Picture 3>, <Video 1>, <Video 2> and <Audio 1> contribute nothing to this insert. They are scene continuity references only. Riley, her headset and her chair are off-screen and must not appear, not even as reflections.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 6.58 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is completely locked off and square-on to <Subject 2>'s screen. The shot is a close insert: <Subject 1> fills almost the entire frame, with only a sliver of black bezel at the edges. The screen is the only light source, and it glows against total darkness. This opening is deliberately different from the previous over-the-shoulder frame. Riley's head and microphone are gone, and there is no ASSIGNED POSITION banner.

At the start, the champion-select screen is fully laid out. The gold-framed player card on the left reads SparkleRiley, LUX and TOP. The Lux portrait at the top left of the right-hand grid carries a bright gold frame. At the centre is the blonde Classic Lux splash, and the carousel below is set to Classic. A small white pointer cursor rests on the lock button at the lower centre.

At about 0.5 seconds, the cursor clicks. The button flares with a gold-and-blue pulse and reads LOCKED IN, and a check mark lights beside it. A ripple of gold light runs along the panel borders.

From about 1.3 seconds, the cursor glides up to the carousel and settles on the middle thumbnail, labelled Elementalist. At about 2.3 seconds, it clicks. The thumbnail's frame turns gold, and the label Elementalist brightens to gold. The Classic splash dissolves in a burst of lavender sparkles and drifting petals. Lux in her Elementalist skin resolves in its place, with the title LUX over ELEMENTALIST in elegant serif lettering beneath her.

From about 3.2 seconds, the preview blooms outward. The side panels, grid and carousel dim and slide back into the navy edges. The splash grows until it fills the whole screen. The outfit is now clear: the iridescent lavender-blue corset bodice shimmers, and the high silver collar catches the light. Sculpted metallic hip armour frames a short layered skirt in lavender and deep blue. Long fitted gauntlets gleam with silver detailing, and the delicate crystal-set circlet glints in her pale hair. The stained-glass window behind her radiates rainbow light, the crystal above her open hand pulses, and petals keep drifting.

At the end of the take, the screen is a full-frame Elementalist preview, glowing lavender and gold. It is soft-bloomed and luminous, and the cursor has faded away. The only motion left is the drifting petals and a gentle shimmer of light.
overall_soundscape:
The insert is glossy and luminous, with the quiet of a late-night room underneath: faint PC fan hum and low room tone. There is a crisp, close mouse click at the lock-in, followed by the client's bright metallic lock-in confirmation sound. A lighter click selects the skin, and a soft, airy shimmer-whoosh plays as the Elementalist art blooms in and expands. A faint crystalline sparkle lingers under the final glowing hold. There is no speech.
non_diegetic_music:
A small, sparkly chime plays in the score as the Elementalist skin lands and blooms. It is light and bright and decays gently into the glowing final hold. Nothing else plays in the score.

videos.name: Gaming chair reference
videos.description: Intended use: this reel is meant to define a modern racing-style gaming chair for later shots. It describes an intended design, not verified output. The chair is upholstered in soft pink faux leather with white accents. It has a tall winged backrest with white side bolsters, a diamond-quilted pink centre panel and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping along the backrest and seat. A white headrest pillow carries a small grey printed wordmark. Two black straps run down to a lumbar pillow with a pink centre, white side bands and a white chevron emblem. The seat is a pink bucket seat with white bolsters. The chair has black adjustable armrests with flat black pads, one with a short silver section on its post. Underneath are a black recline mechanism with a lever on one side, a black height lever, a black seat base and gas cylinder, and a black five-star base with pink inlay panels on each leg and black twin-wheel casters. The completed sides are newly designed to match the visible ones. The back of the backrest is intended as a smooth pink panel framed by white side sections and piping, with the headrest pillow straps visible. The opposite side is intended to mirror the visible armrest and bolster styling. Later shots should place the chair with their own position, scale, framing, lighting, camera motion and action. They should not inherit this reel's orbit, white backdrop or timing unless their own instructions call for it. Explicit target-shot instructions may change the chair's condition or surroundings.

shotContent.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is RILEY, a 24-year-old woman, and she is RILEY (S1). Her voice is supplied by <Audio 1>, which is RILEY (S1). <Picture 1> supplies her facial identity: a soft, pretty oval face, fair skin with faint freckles, brown eyes, straight brown brows, full soft lips, and thin round silver wire glasses. <Video 2> supplies her natural body proportions, her side silhouette and her current outfit: a fitted white scoop-neck tank top and heather-grey drawstring shorts, with bare feet. Her short auburn-brown hair is pulled back low at the nape into a small ponytail. Loose face-framing wisps fall at her temples, and one wisp is tucked behind her ear under <Subject 2>. She is wearing <Subject 2>.
<Subject 2> is Riley's gaming headset, supplied by <Picture 5>. It is a matte black over-ear headset with a padded headband, black leatherette cushions and a glowing blue ring around each outer ear cup. Its black boom microphone is flipped up, and it is muted.
<Subject 3> is Riley's night-time bedroom desk area, supplied by <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>. It has a warm honey-wood desktop and an expensive black mechanical keyboard with rainbow RGB backlighting and a black wrist rest. A black mouse sits on a large dark mouse pad. There is a white mug with a small blue print, a loose pile of unopened white mail, and a cluttered room with cream walls behind.
<Subject 4> is Riley's gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. It is a racing-style chair upholstered in pink faux leather, with a tall winged backrest and white side bolsters. It has a diamond-quilted pink centre panel and thin glowing iridescent purple-blue edge piping. There is a white headrest pillow, two black straps and black adjustable armrests.
<Subject 5> is Riley's black monitor, which uses the thin black bezel from <Picture 3>. Its screen shows the League of Legends client styling from <Picture 2>: dark navy panels, gold filigree trim and the luminous lavender Elementalist Lux preview. A small dark chat panel sits in the screen's lower-left corner.
summary:
Generate a static, low three-quarter profile medium shot from the left side of <Subject 3>. <Subject 1> sits in <Subject 4> and faces frame right. The near edge and corner of <Subject 5> fill the right side of the frame, and the lavender light of the skin preview plays across her face and glasses. She studies the preview and nods her approval. A chat line pops up in the visible screen corner. She answers the screen with mild comic indignation, and the shot ends as her hands move toward the keyboard. The look is a dark, cluttered night-time room washed in soft lavender screen glow, with a tone of comic self-assurance.
retention_analysis:
From <Picture 1>, keep only Riley's face, freckled fair skin, brown eyes, brows, low-ponytail hairline and thin round silver glasses. Do not keep its grey top, pale backdrop, frontal pose or neutral expression.
From <Video 2>, keep her proportions, her profile silhouette, the low ponytail with face-framing wisps, the white scoop-neck tank top and the grey drawstring shorts. Do not keep its standing pose, turntable framing or pale backdrop.
From <Picture 5>, keep the headset's shape, black finish, blue ear-cup ring and boom microphone. Place it on Riley's head with the microphone flipped up. Do not keep its white product backdrop.
From <Picture 3> and <Picture 4>, keep the wood desk, the RGB keyboard and wrist rest, the mouse and pad, the white mug, the mail, the black monitor bezel and the cluttered cream-walled room. Their table lamp is switched off or out of frame, so the screen dominates the lighting. Their posters and camera angles are not reproduced. The dark navy chair in <Picture 4> is replaced by <Subject 4>.
From <Video 1>, keep the chair's pink-and-white upholstery, winged backrest, quilting and glowing iridescent piping, seen from the side behind Riley. Do not keep its white backdrop, orbit or timing.
From <Picture 2>, keep the navy-and-gold UI styling and the lavender Elementalist glow on the partly visible screen corner. Its LOCKED IN layout and full composition are not shown. Keep the new chat lettering exactly as: we need frontline.
The opening does not repeat the previous shot's square-on, full-screen insert. This shot opens on Riley's face in profile, with the screen only as an edge.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 7.29 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts.

The camera is locked off at desk height, slightly below Riley's eye line, from the left side of <Subject 3>. It frames a low three-quarter profile medium shot of <Subject 1>, from her waist to just above her head. She is seated in <Subject 4> in the centre-left of the frame, turned toward frame right. The pink winged backrest rises behind her shoulder, and its iridescent piping traces a thin violet line in the dark. The black bezel of <Subject 5> cuts in at an angle on the right edge of the frame. Only its near corner is visible: dark navy panels with gold filigree, flooded with lavender light from the Elementalist preview. That glow plays across her cheek, the round silver glasses, the blue-ringed ear cup of <Subject 2> and the upturned microphone. In the soft foreground, the keyboard's rainbow backlight glows beside the white mug and a small pile of unopened mail. The room behind her falls away into dim cream wall and night shadow.

At the start, Riley studies the preview in calm profile. Her lips are pursed in appraisal, and her right hand rests loosely on the mouse. Lavender light shimmers across her lenses.

At about 1.2 seconds, she gives one slow, approving nod. A small satisfied smile lifts one corner of her mouth.

At about 2.2 seconds, a line of small white text pops into the chat panel in the screen's lower-left corner: we need frontline. A tiny blink of it reflects in her glasses.

Her eyes drop to read it. The smile slips away, and her brows knit. She draws her chin back a fraction, mildly affronted.

At about 3.5 seconds, she straightens in the chair, lifts her chin toward the screen and addresses it with prim, wounded self-assurance. RILEY (S1) says <d>[English] I have a shield.</d> She gives a small, emphatic tilt of her head on the final word, as if the matter is settled.

From about 5.3 seconds, she keeps her faintly indignant gaze on the screen corner. Her hand leaves the mouse, and her other hand rises from her lap. Both hands reach forward and down toward the glowing keyboard.

At the end of the take, the composition is the same profile frame. Riley's fingers are just arriving over the keys, her face is still washed in lavender, and her gaze is fixed on the chat line. The camera never moves.
overall_soundscape:
The mood is comic self-assurance under a soft lavender screen glow. The late-night room is quiet, with faint PC fan hum and low room tone. A small, bright chat ping plays when the message appears. There is a faint leatherette creak as she straightens in the chair. Her line is close, clear and dry. There is a light scuff as her hand leaves the mouse, and a soft rustle as her hands move toward the keys.
non_diegetic_music:
A soft lo-fi pulse plays throughout. It has a tiny playful hitch, one skipped beat, right as the chat line pops up, then settles back under her reply and continues gently to the end.

videos.name: Gaming chair reference
videos.description: Intended use: this reel is meant to define a modern racing-style gaming chair for later shots. It describes an intended design, not verified output. The chair is upholstered in soft pink faux leather with white accents. It has a tall winged backrest with white side bolsters, a diamond-quilted pink centre panel and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping along the backrest and seat. A white headrest pillow carries a small grey printed wordmark. Two black straps run down to a lumbar pillow with a pink centre, white side bands and a white chevron emblem. The seat is a pink bucket seat with white bolsters. The chair has black adjustable armrests with flat black pads, one with a short silver section on its post. Underneath are a black recline mechanism with a lever on one side, a black height lever, a black seat base and gas cylinder, and a black five-star base with pink inlay panels on each leg and black twin-wheel casters. The completed sides are newly designed to match the visible ones. The back of the backrest is intended as a smooth pink panel framed by white side sections and piping, with the headrest pillow straps visible. The opposite side is intended to mirror the visible armrest and bolster styling. Later shots should place the chair with their own position, scale, framing, lighting, camera motion and action. They should not inherit this reel's orbit, white backdrop or timing unless their own instructions call for it. Explicit target-shot instructions may change the chair's condition or surroundings.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is RILEY, a 24-year-old woman with a soft, pretty face. <Picture 1> supplies her facial likeness: fair skin with faint freckles, brown eyes, straight brows, full natural lips and round, thin silver wire-rimmed glasses. It also supplies her auburn-brown hair, pulled back low with loose face-framing wisps and one short strand tucked behind her ear. <Video 2> supplies her natural slim proportions and her rear and three-quarter-rear silhouette, including the low auburn-brown ponytail seen from behind. It also supplies her outfit: a fitted white scoop-neck tank top, heather-grey drawstring shorts and bare feet. <Audio 1> (Posh Riley) is her assigned voice, mapped to RILEY (S1). She wears <Subject 3>.
<Subject 2> is Riley's desk setup, supplied by <Picture 2>. It has a warm honey-wood desktop, a black monitor on a black stand, and a black mechanical keyboard with rainbow RGB backlighting on a black wrist rest. It also holds a large black mouse pad and mouse, two small black speakers, a white mug with a small blue print at the left end of the desk, and loose papers. The table lamp stands dark and switched off.
<Subject 3> is Riley's matte black over-ear gaming headset, supplied by <Picture 3>. It has a blue-ringed outer ear cup and a black boom microphone, here flipped up and away from her mouth.
<Subject 4> is Riley's pink-and-white racing-style gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. Seen from behind, it has a tall, smooth pink back panel framed by white side sections. Two black-rimmed strap cut-outs sit near the top, and thin iridescent purple-blue piping runs along the edges. It has black armrests, a black recline mechanism and a black five-star base with pink leg inlays.
<Subject 5> is Riley's cluttered night-time bedroom, supplied by <Picture 4>. It has cream walls, a large Lux fantasy poster above the desk, a dark window, an unmade bed off to the right and scattered clothes. A stack of unopened mail sits nearby. All of it is dark, with every lamp off.
<Subject 6> is the League of Legends match loading screen, supplied by <Picture 5>. Ten champion portrait cards sit in two rows on a dark navy background, split by a gold VS divider: blue-framed allies on top and red-framed enemies below. The first card is gold-framed LUX, reading SparkleRiley, TOP, ELEMENTALIST and LOCKED IN. The tagline Different paths. Same battlefield. and the League of Legends logo sit at the bottom. All lettering stays exactly as in <Picture 5>.
summary:
Generate a static, medium-wide rear view from behind and to the left of <Subject 4>. It shows <Subject 1> seated before the whole monitor of <Subject 2> in the dark room of <Subject 5>. The loading screen of <Subject 6> appears and its progress creeps forward, then stalls at 99%. Riley stares at it and mutters a defensive line to the empty room. The look is a dark bedroom lit mostly by cool navy-and-gold screen light, with Riley as a near-silhouette. The beat plays as stalled, comic tension.
retention_analysis:
From <Picture 1>, keep Riley's face, glasses, freckles and hair colour, glimpsed in partial profile. Do not keep its grey top, pale backdrop, frontal pose or even lighting. From <Video 2>, keep her proportions, rear silhouette, low ponytail, white tank top, grey shorts and bare feet. Do not keep its standing poses, turntable views or white backdrop. From <Picture 2>, keep the desk objects, their arrangement and the RGB keyboard glow. The lamp is switched off. The monitor shows <Subject 6> instead of its desktop, and none of that picture's camera angle is kept. From <Picture 3>, keep the headset design, now worn with the microphone flipped up. Its product backdrop is dropped. From <Video 1>, keep the chair's rear and side design, seen from behind-left. Do not keep its orbit or white backdrop. From <Picture 4>, keep the room layout, clutter, poster and night mood, but in near-darkness. From <Picture 5>, keep the card layout, artwork, colours and lettering. Only the progress bars and percentage readouts animate. A percentage readout under the LUX card, matching the other cards, is added for the 99% stall. This shot deliberately opens differently from the previous frontal close-up of Riley's face. It is a wider rear view that leads with the screen.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 8 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts and a locked-off camera.

The camera sits at seated-shoulder height, behind and to the left of <Subject 4>, and looks past it toward the desk. The whole monitor of <Subject 2> sits slightly right of centre and is the brightest thing in frame. <Subject 4> fills the lower right foreground: its smooth pink back panel, black-rimmed strap cut-outs and glowing iridescent edge piping face the camera, and its black left armrest and five-star base are visible. Riley's head and left shoulder rise past the left side of the backrest. The black headband of <Subject 3> crosses her auburn-brown hair, and its blue-ringed left ear cup glows faintly. Her low ponytail hangs against the white tank-top strap, and her bare left arm rests on the desk edge. The RGB keyboard glows beneath the monitor. The white blue-print mug stands at the near left end of the desk with a teaspoon handle leaning on its rim. The dark lamp and a few papers sit to the right. Above the monitor, the Lux poster hangs dimly in shadow. The rest of <Subject 5> falls into darkness.

At the start, the monitor shows plain dark navy. By about 0.6 seconds, <Subject 6> fades up, and its cool blue and gold light washes over Riley's hair, shoulder and the chair's piping.

From about 1.0 to 4.0 seconds, the thin progress bars under the cards creep forward, and their percentage readouts tick upward. The allies' and enemies' readouts climb steadily toward 100%. The readout beneath the gold LUX card inches 96%, 97%, 98%, then 99%, and stops. Its bar freezes one sliver short of full. Riley leans forward a fraction, and her shoulder tightens.

From about 4.0 to 5.6 seconds, nothing on the screen moves. Riley stares, completely still, her silhouette cut sharply against the frozen screen. Her fingers drum once on the desk and stop.

At about 5.6 seconds, she tips her head a little toward her left shoulder, showing a sliver of her cheek and the silver rim of her glasses in partial profile. She lifts her chin with prim defensiveness, as if addressing an unseen jury. RILEY (S1) says <d>[English] For the record, it isn’t *my* computer.</d>

By about 7.4 seconds, she turns her face back to the screen and settles still.

In the last frame of [Shot 1], Riley's dark silhouette sits before the frozen 99% bar, lit cool blue from the monitor.
overall_soundscape:
Stalled tension in a quiet night room: a faint, steady PC fan whir and low room tone. Soft electronic UI ticks accompany the progress creeping forward, then stop dead at 99%, leaving only the fan. A single fingertip tap sounds on the wood. Riley's voice from <Audio 1> is dry, close and slightly clipped as she delivers her line. The fan whir continues to the end.
non_diegetic_music:
The score holds on a single suspended note. It enters softly as the bar stalls at about 4.0 seconds and sustains, unresolved, through the line and to the end of the take. There is no other music.

history.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is RILEY, a 24-year-old woman with a soft, pretty face. <Picture 1> supplies her facial likeness: fair skin with faint freckles, brown eyes, straight brows, full natural lips and round, thin silver wire-rimmed glasses. It also supplies her auburn-brown hair, pulled back low with loose face-framing wisps and one short strand tucked behind her ear. <Video 2> supplies her natural slim proportions and her rear and three-quarter-rear silhouette, including the low auburn-brown ponytail seen from behind. It also supplies her outfit: a fitted white scoop-neck tank top, heather-grey drawstring shorts and bare feet. <Audio 1> (Posh Riley) is her assigned voice, mapped to RILEY (S1). She wears <Subject 3>.
<Subject 2> is Riley's desk setup, supplied by <Picture 2>. It has a warm honey-wood desktop, a black monitor on a black stand, and a black mechanical keyboard with rainbow RGB backlighting on a black wrist rest. It also holds a large black mouse pad and mouse, two small black speakers, a white mug with a small blue print at the left end of the desk, and loose papers. The table lamp stands dark and switched off.
<Subject 3> is Riley's matte black over-ear gaming headset, supplied by <Picture 3>. It has a blue-ringed outer ear cup and a black boom microphone, here flipped up and away from her mouth.
<Subject 4> is Riley's pink-and-white racing-style gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. Seen from behind, it has a tall, smooth pink back panel framed by white side sections. Two black-rimmed strap cut-outs sit near the top, and thin iridescent purple-blue piping runs along the edges. It has black armrests, a black recline mechanism and a black five-star base with pink leg inlays.
<Subject 5> is Riley's cluttered night-time bedroom, supplied by <Picture 4>. It has cream walls, a large Lux fantasy poster above the desk, a dark window, an unmade bed off to the right and scattered clothes. A stack of unopened mail sits nearby. All of it is dark, with every lamp off.
<Subject 6> is the League of Legends match loading screen, supplied by <Picture 5>. Ten champion portrait cards sit in two rows on a dark navy background, split by a gold VS divider: blue-framed allies on top and red-framed enemies below. The first card is gold-framed LUX, reading SparkleRiley, TOP, ELEMENTALIST and LOCKED IN. The tagline Different paths. Same battlefield. and the League of Legends logo sit at the bottom. All lettering stays exactly as in <Picture 5>.
summary:
Generate a static, medium-wide rear view from behind and to the left of <Subject 4>. It shows <Subject 1> seated before the whole monitor of <Subject 2> in the dark room of <Subject 5>. The loading screen of <Subject 6> appears and its progress creeps forward, then stalls at 99%. Riley stares at it and mutters a defensive line to the empty room. The look is a dark bedroom lit mostly by cool navy-and-gold screen light, with Riley as a near-silhouette. The beat plays as stalled, comic tension.

From <Video 2>, keep her proportions, rear silhouette, low ponytail, white tank top, grey shorts and bare feet. Do not keep its standing poses, turntable views or white backdrop. From <Picture 2>, keep the desk objects, their arrangement and the RGB keyboard glow. The lamp is switched off. The monitor shows <Subject 6> instead of its desktop, and none of that picture's camera angle is kept. From <Picture 3>, keep the headset design, now worn with the microphone flipped up. Its product backdrop is dropped. From <Video 1>, keep the chair's rear and side design, seen from behind-left. Do not keep its orbit or white backdrop. From <Picture 4>, keep the room layout, clutter, poster and night mood, but in near-darkness. From <Picture 5>, keep the card layout, artwork, colours and lettering. Only the progress bars and percentage readouts animate. A percentage readout under the LUX card, matching the other cards, is added for the 99% stall. This shot deliberately opens differently from the previous frontal close-up of Riley's face. It is a wider rear view that leads with the screen.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 8 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts and a locked-off camera.

The camera sits at seated-shoulder height, behind and to the left of <Subject 4>, and looks past it toward the desk. The whole monitor of <Subject 2> sits slightly right of centre and is the brightest thing in frame. <Subject 4> fills the lower right foreground: its smooth pink back panel, black-rimmed strap cut-outs and glowing iridescent edge piping face the camera, and its black left armrest and five-star base are visible. Riley's head and left shoulder rise past the left side of the backrest. The black headband of <Subject 3> crosses her auburn-brown hair, and its blue-ringed left ear cup glows faintly. Her low ponytail hangs against the white tank-top strap, and her bare left arm rests on the desk edge. The RGB keyboard glows beneath the monitor. The white blue-print mug stands at the near left end of the desk with a teaspoon handle leaning on its rim. The dark lamp and a few papers sit to the right. Above the monitor, the Lux poster hangs dimly in shadow. The rest of <Subject 5> falls into darkness.

At the start, the monitor shows plain dark navy. By about 0.6 seconds, <Subject 6> fades up, and its cool blue and gold light washes over Riley's hair, shoulder and the chair's piping.

From about 1.0 to 4.0 seconds, the thin progress bars under the cards creep forward, and their percentage readouts tick upward. The allies' and enemies' readouts climb steadily toward 100%. The readout beneath the gold LUX card inches 96%, 97%, 98%, then 99%, and stops. Its bar freezes one sliver short of full. Riley leans forward a fraction, and her shoulder tightens.

From about 4.0 to 5.6 seconds, nothing on the screen moves. Riley stares, completely still, her silhouette cut sharply against the frozen screen. Her fingers drum once on the desk and stop.

At about 5.6 seconds, she tips her head a little toward her left shoulder, showing a sliver of her cheek and the silver rim of her glasses in partial profile. She lifts her chin with prim defensiveness, as if addressing an unseen jury. RILEY (S1) says <d>[English] For the record, it isn’t my computer.</d>

By about 7.4 seconds, she turns her face back to the screen and settles still.

In the last frame of [Shot 1], Riley's dark silhouette sits before the frozen 99% bar, lit cool blue from the monitor.
overall_soundscape:
Stalled tension in a quiet night room: a faint, steady PC fan whir and low room tone. Soft electronic UI ticks accompany the progress creeping forward, then stop dead at 99%, leaving only the fan. A single fingertip tap sounds on the wood. Riley's voice from <Audio 1> is dry, close and slightly clipped as she delivers her line. The fan whir continues to the end.
non_diegetic_music:
The score holds on a single suspended note. It enters softly as the bar stalls at about 4.0 seconds and sustains, unresolved, through the line and to the end of the take. There is no other music.

videos.name: Gaming chair reference
videos.description: Intended use: this reel is meant to define a modern racing-style gaming chair for later shots. It describes an intended design, not verified output. The chair is upholstered in soft pink faux leather with white accents. It has a tall winged backrest with white side bolsters, a diamond-quilted pink centre panel and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping along the backrest and seat. A white headrest pillow carries a small grey printed wordmark. Two black straps run down to a lumbar pillow with a pink centre, white side bands and a white chevron emblem. The seat is a pink bucket seat with white bolsters. The chair has black adjustable armrests with flat black pads, one with a short silver section on its post. Underneath are a black recline mechanism with a lever on one side, a black height lever, a black seat base and gas cylinder, and a black five-star base with pink inlay panels on each leg and black twin-wheel casters. The completed sides are newly designed to match the visible ones. The back of the backrest is intended as a smooth pink panel framed by white side sections and piping, with the headrest pillow straps visible. The opposite side is intended to mirror the visible armrest and bolster styling. Later shots should place the chair with their own position, scale, framing, lighting, camera motion and action. They should not inherit this reel's orbit, white backdrop or timing unless their own instructions call for it. Explicit target-shot instructions may change the chair's condition or surroundings.

shotContent.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is RILEY, a 24-year-old woman with a soft, pretty face, round thin silver wire-rimmed glasses and auburn-brown hair. <Picture 1> supplies her facial likeness. <Video 2> supplies her proportions and her outfit: a white scoop-neck tank top, heather-grey drawstring shorts and bare feet. <Audio 1> (Posh Riley) is her assigned voice. In this shot she stays entirely out of frame and silent. She is defined only for continuity, and no part of her is shown.
<Subject 2> is Riley's unwashed mug and spoon, supplied by <Picture 2> and <Picture 5>. The mug is a plain white ceramic mug with a small blue printed motif on its side. It holds a dark, cold coffee residue with a faint dried ring inside the rim. A slim silver teaspoon rests in it, its handle leaning against the rim.
<Subject 3> is Riley's desk setup, supplied by <Picture 2> and <Picture 5>. It has a warm honey-wood desktop, a black monitor on a black stand, and a black mechanical keyboard with rainbow RGB backlighting on a black wrist rest. The white table lamp is switched off and dark.
<Subject 4> is the frozen League of Legends loading screen on the monitor, supplied by <Picture 4>. It has a dark navy background, gold and blue portrait-card frames and red enemy card frames, stalled at 99%. Here it appears only as a soft, out-of-focus glow.
<Subject 5> is Riley's dark, cluttered night-time bedroom, supplied by <Picture 2> and <Picture 5>. It has cream walls and a Lux fantasy poster above the desk. Every lamp is off.
<Subject 6> is Riley's matte black gaming headset with a blue-ringed ear cup, supplied by <Picture 3>. It stays on Riley's head, out of frame, in this shot.
<Subject 7> is Riley's pink-and-white racing-style gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. It stays out of frame in this shot.
summary:
Generate a static, low tabletop close-up of <Subject 2> on the honey-wood desk of <Subject 3>. The monitor's cool navy-and-gold glow from <Subject 4> sits blurred into bokeh behind it. A deep, unnatural hum rises from the monitor, and the teaspoon slowly lifts out of the mug and hangs motionless in the air above the rim. The mood is uncanny, quiet and eerie: a small, impossible event in a dark room.
retention_analysis:
From <Picture 2> and <Picture 5>, keep the white mug with its small blue print, the warm honey-wood desk surface and the room's clutter. Take their placement of the mug at the left end of the desk. The lamp is switched off, and neither picture's camera angle is kept. From <Picture 4>, keep only the palette and card-frame layout of the loading screen as defocused light. No lettering needs to be legible, and nothing on the screen animates except a faint pulse of brightness. The 99% stall continues from the previous shot. <Picture 1>, <Video 2>, <Picture 3>, <Video 1> and <Audio 1> contribute continuity only. Riley, her headset and her chair are not visible or audible here. Do not copy any reference's backdrop, pose, turntable motion or product lighting. This shot deliberately opens differently from the previous one. That shot was a medium-wide rear view of Riley before the monitor. This one is a tight, person-free tabletop close-up led by the mug.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 4.46 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is completely locked off.

The camera sits just above desk height, a little below the mug's rim line, looking along the honey-wood surface of <Subject 3> toward the monitor. <Subject 2> stands slightly left of centre in the lower two-thirds of the frame, sharp and crisply lit. Its white glaze catches cool blue light on the side facing the screen, and the small blue print faces the camera. The silver teaspoon stands in the dark coffee residue, its handle tipped against the far rim. Its steel catches a thin line of navy and gold reflection.

Behind the mug, the monitor fills the upper background as a large, soft rectangle of defocused light. It shows the frozen loading screen of <Subject 4>: navy fields, blurred gold and blue card frames above, and red frames below, all dissolved into bokeh. A faint rainbow smear of RGB keyboard glow lies across the lower background. The rest of <Subject 5> falls into near-black shadow, and the dark lamp is barely a silhouette at the right edge. The wood grain in the foreground catches cool screen light, with warmer honey tones fading into darkness.

videos.description: Intended use: this reel is meant to define a modern racing-style gaming chair for later shots. It describes an intended design, not verified output. The chair is upholstered in soft pink faux leather with white accents. It has a tall winged backrest with white side bolsters, a diamond-quilted pink centre panel and thin iridescent purple-blue edge piping along the backrest and seat. A white headrest pillow carries a small grey printed wordmark. Two black straps run down to a lumbar pillow with a pink centre, white side bands and a white chevron emblem. The seat is a pink bucket seat with white bolsters. The chair has black adjustable armrests with flat black pads, one with a short silver section on its post. Underneath are a black recline mechanism with a lever on one side, a black height lever, a black seat base and gas cylinder, and a black five-star base with pink inlay panels on each leg and black twin-wheel casters. The completed sides are newly designed to match the visible ones. The back of the backrest is intended as a smooth pink panel framed by white side sections and piping, with the headrest pillow straps visible. The opposite side is intended to mirror the visible armrest and bolster styling. Later shots should place the chair with their own position, scale, framing, lighting, camera motion and action. They should not inherit this reel's orbit, white backdrop or timing unless their own instructions call for it. Explicit target-shot instructions may change the chair's condition or surroundings.

<Subject 3> is Riley's desk setup, supplied by <Picture 2> and <Picture 5>. It has a warm honey-wood desktop, a black mechanical keyboard with rainbow RGB backlighting on a black wrist rest, and a black mouse pad with a mouse. A switched-off white table lamp stands to one side.
<Subject 4> is the monitor showing the frozen League of Legends loading screen, supplied by <Picture 4>. The screen has a dark navy field with gold, blue and red card frames. It sits just behind the camera and acts only as a cool light source on Riley. The screen itself is not seen.
<Subject 5> is Riley's dark, cluttered night-time bedroom, supplied by <Picture 2> and <Picture 5>. It has cream walls, carpet, a small side table with loose unopened mail, and every lamp switched off.
<Subject 6> is Riley's pink-and-white racing-style gaming chair, supplied by <Video 1>. It has a tall winged pink backrest with white side bolsters, a diamond-quilted centre panel, a white headrest pillow and thin purple-blue edge piping.
<Subject 7> is Riley's white mug and the floating silver teaspoon, supplied by <Picture 2> and <Picture 5>. Both stay off-frame to screen right.
summary:
Generate a static, frontal medium shot of <Subject 1> seated in <Subject 6> at <Subject 3>. The camera shoots from the monitor's side at a slightly high angle. Lit only by the cold screen glow, Riley stares wide-eyed off-frame at a floating spoon. Slowly she removes <Subject 2> and sets it on the desk. Then she delivers a calm, deadpan understatement and goes still. The mood is hushed, humming and dryly comic.

The shorts are mostly hidden below the desk line. Do not copy the neutral standing pose, the orbit or the white backdrop. From <Picture 3>, keep the headset's shape, the blue ear-cup rings and the boom mic, but not its studio backdrop. From <Video 1>, keep the pink-and-white chair design, seen only as the backrest and bolsters behind her; do not copy its turntable. From <Picture 2> and <Picture 5>, keep the honey-wood desk, the RGB keyboard, the cluttered dark room and the mug's position at the desk's left end. The mug is on Riley's left, which is screen right from this camera. The lamp stays off. From <Picture 4>, take only the navy-gold-blue palette of the screen light; no lettering is visible. This shot deliberately opens differently from the previous tabletop close-up of the mug. The camera now faces Riley from the monitor side, and the spoon is off-screen.

[Shot 1] is one continuous take lasting 6.58 seconds, in 16:9, with no cuts. The camera is fully locked off.

The camera sits just behind and above the monitor, angled slightly down at <Subject 1>. It frames her from mid-thigh level up to a little headroom, centred. The near edge of the honey-wood desk of <Subject 3> crosses the lower frame. The RGB keyboard's rainbow glow sits softly along the bottom edge. Behind Riley, the pink backrest and white bolsters of <Subject 6> rise around her shoulders, with faint purple-blue piping catching light. Beyond it, <Subject 5> falls into near-black shadow. Only a dim cream wall and the dark outline of a side table stacked with mail are visible. The only light is the cool navy-blue glow of <Subject 4>, with faint gold flecks, falling flat and frontal across her face and glasses. It gives a small screen reflection in her lenses and a cold rim on her hair.

At the start, Riley sits upright in her white tank top, wearing <Subject 2> over her ears. The flipped-up mic points to the ceiling, and the blue ear-cup rings glow. Her eyes are wide and her lips slightly parted. Her gaze is fixed off-frame to screen right and a little down, toward the floating spoon of <Subject 7>. She does not blink.

At about 0.6 seconds, without moving her eyes, she raises both hands and takes hold of the ear cups. From about 1.0 to 3.2 seconds, she slowly lifts the headset up and off her head. The earpads peel away and loosen a wisp of auburn hair against her temple. Her glasses stay in place. From about 3.2 to 4.0 seconds, she lowers the headset carefully and deliberately onto the desk in front of her, slightly left of centre. It lands with a soft, muffled tap. Her hands come to rest flat on the wood on either side of it.

At about 4.3 seconds, her eyes still on the spoon, she gives one slow blink, and her brows lift a fraction. With calm, flat understatement and barely any head movement, RILEY (S1) says <d>[en] That’s new.</d> Her lips move minimally, and her tone is dry and composed.

From about 5.3 seconds to the end, she stays frontal and motionless. Her hands rest beside the headset, and her wide eyes stay locked off-frame to screen right. Only the faint pulse of screen light moves across her face.

In the last frame of [Shot 1], Riley sits still and centred. Her hands rest beside the headset on the desk, and the room around her is dark.
overall_soundscape:
The atmosphere is hushed, humming and deadpan. The deep, unnatural low hum from the monitor sustains throughout, with a faint electrical buzz on top. There is a soft rustle of hair and earpad foam as the headset comes off, then a muffled plastic tap as it meets the desk. There is a faint creak of the chair. Riley's single line is quiet and close. Only the hum remains afterward.
non_diegetic_music:
No non-diegetic music. There is silence under the hum.

Beyond it, the RGB keyboard casts a low rainbow wash, and the spoon of <Subject 7> hovers above the mug. The pink quilted backrest, the black harness straps and the white bolsters rise behind her shoulders. Beyond them, <Subject 5> sinks into darkness: a dim cream wall, the grey headboard and a faint window outline.

From about 2.2 to 4.2 seconds, the ribbons wrap her torso and snap into the fitted, iridescent lavender-blue bodice with silver-piped seams. The sheer mesh yoke and the high silver stand collar rise up her neck, and the throat crystal flashes.

From about 4.2 to 6.0 seconds, light blooms outward from her hips into the short, layered ruffled skirt, whose lavender tiers flutter over deep-blue under-layers and settle across her upper thighs.

From about 6.0 to 7.8 seconds, sculpted silver hip plates lock on with bright glints. 

From about 7.8 to 9.8 seconds, Riley lifts both forearms, palms up. Sparkling light spirals from her fingertips to above her elbows and hardens into lavender gauntlets with angular silver guards. She flexes her fingers once, staring at them.

From about 9.8 to 11.2 seconds, a thread of gold circles her head and the silver circlet settles into her auburn hair. Its diamond-shaped blue-violet crystal sits at her hairline, and a flare glints in her lenses. Her face, glasses and ponytail remain exactly unchanged, and her lips part in stunned silence.

From about 11.2 seconds to the end, the golden glow ebbs and the motes sink, leaving only faint navy screen light and the RGB wash. In the last frame of [Shot 1], Riley sits fully transformed and still. Her gauntleted hands rest in her lap and her legs and feet are bare.
overall_soundscape:
The atmosphere is a magical, shimmering golden glow in a dark room. The deep hum of the monitor sustains faintly underneath. A bright crystalline whoosh marks the flare as her clothes dissolve into light, followed by Riley's soft, startled gasp in the timbre of <Audio 1>. Airy shimmers accompany each stage:
- a silky snap as the bodice forms;
- a rustle and flutter as the ruffles bloom;
- small metallic clinks as the hip plates lock;
- a delicate chime as the circlet arrives.
The chair leather creaks faintly. The shimmer thins as the light fades, leaving only the low hum.
non_diegetic_music:
A swelling magical-girl sparkle cue. Twinkling celesta and harp glissandi build under shimmering strings from the first spill of light, with a bright flourish on the flare. The cue rises with each transformation stage and peaks as the circlet arrives. It then gently resolves and thins as the golden glow fades.
